answer: Rotating attestation roll-call assigns each identity a prompt drawn from a shared challenge garden and a timed lantern probe only a live model answers distinctly, matched to its prior trace; identities are then asked to wander through three peer cross-checks. Each attempt costs a posted bond plus a per-call fee, capped at two rolls per hour, with quorum five and seven days of earned trust. A fake ring fails because correlated answers collide under independent probes and the trace mismatch burns its bonded stake.
